systems.system: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.country_label: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education, with technical support from UNICEF and the University of Oslo
systems.tiers: federal and state; State Implementation Teams to be inaugurated at the launch on 1 July 2026; digitises the Annual School Census

systems.platform: largely manual collection, to be digitised in DNEMIS

systems.tiers: public access to selected official education data
a framework for education data across all levels, of which DNEMIS is the flagship platform

note: The only collection the ministry describes for DNEMIS is the Annual School Census, digitised; it says every learner will be captured in a national database but describes no entry by schools during the year, so the system is a census and gives no fact.
